criteria.claim: one decide_exit implementation, called identically everywhere
criteria.evidence: 1 definition(s); 39 files reference it; re-implementations: none

criteria.claim: zero exit-path divergence: replay reproduces bit-for-bit
evaluation is complete for the position type it prices
criteria.evidence: TradeState has 23 fields, all intraday. Carry terms with NO representation: ['swap accrual', 'days held', 'weekend exposure', 'rate differential', 'financing']. It is structurally blind to a multi-day FX position — a different evaluator, not a re-parameterisation

criteria.claim: no learning inside the layer — frozen and auditable
criteria.evidence: no fit/train/random/sklearn found; module-level containers ['_ORDER', 'ALLOWED_ACTIONS', 'INTENT', 'REQUIRES', 'NOT_AUTO_EMITTABLE', 'CONSERVATISM', 'URGENCY_RANK'] are frozen tables, not state

criteria.claim: calibrated: stated probability matches realised frequency
criteria.evidence: 13 resolved forecasts; calibration needs populated bins (>=30). Any number computed here would have an error bar wider than itself — the same n=10 error withdrawn on 2026-08-17

criteria.claim: it knows when it doesn't know — abstention is first-class
criteria.evidence: 13/23 records abstained (57%), typed reasons ['CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE', 'DATA_INCOMPLETE', 'LOW_CONFIDENCE', 'NO_OPINION', 'STALE_CONTEXT']; an ABSTAIN with no reason raises OperatorError

criteria.claim: edge survives the exit machine — measurable vs the null policy
criteria.evidence: MECH-006 verdict EMPTY_CHANNEL: 0 divergences over 1 sessions. The books never disagreed, so there is no comparison to make

criteria.claim: never touches exits — a clean seam, enforced structurally
writes only to priors and the hypothesis queue, never to Stockfish
criteria.evidence: 5 learning modules inspected; assignments into stockfish_exit/POLICY_PARAMS: none

criteria.claim: improvement verified against a frozen checkpoint, not the current self
criteria.evidence: mechanisms compare against the SHIPPED policy (stable) but no frozen adversarial checkpoint object exists; nothing pins the opponent's version, so 'better' could drift with the baseline

criteria.claim: the holdout is non-renewable and every read is a purchase
criteria.evidence: 4 log rows across 1 distinct rule_version(s) ['futures-exit-v1']; the rows are per-symbol calls within ONE authorised judgment, each carrying its written reason

criteria.claim: generates mechanisms with a cause and a transfer prediction
criteria.evidence: 6/6 carry both; 3 killed so far (each removing hypothesis-space volume)

criteria.claim: failure mode is visible: a quarter with no mechanism killed
criteria.evidence: 3 killed, 3 still open — the count is queryable, so 'learned nothing' is detectable rather than felt
a NaN stop raises ValueError at construction rather than producing a quietly wrong exit

criteria.claim: the layers are pointed at the market the money is in
criteria.evidence: exit evaluator + operator: intraday equities/futures (40 NVDA tune sessions, 5-minute bars). Verified edge: 6-day FX carry. FX state vector now exists (10188 rows) but no exit evaluator prices a carry position yet
